The insert fields include `getFormFieldSqlNames($gesamtPlan->jahr, 'massnahme')` = for 2027, which is empty (no dynform_field for 2027). But note getFormFieldSqlNames filters `type != 'Header'` and `name != 'Ident'`, and only active. Wait, it returns fields, but the first call has `return array_keys(...)` with backtick-wrapped values overwritten to array_keys of the same result, so it returns raw names. There's a bug there: they build `$data` with backticks then return `array_keys(Page::Db()->queryToPrimaryKeyArray($sql, 'name'))` again — the raw names. Hmm, actually that returns the same keys, so it works. For 2027 empty, so $moreFields = ''. Then insertFields ends with `full_text,` and selectFields ends with `full_text,` -> trailing commas -> SQL syntax error. Actually wait: `$insertFields = 'Ident,lft_nummer,fk_gesamtplan,fk_dienststelle,status_markiert,redakteur_level,fk_kopie_von,full_text,'` and then `. $moreFields`. If $moreFields empty, we get trailing comma. That's a syntax error -> error (2).

But wait, is that an app defect or a data-state issue? For the documented workflow, the new Gesamtplan copies dynform_field from previous version. 2027 was created via createGesamtplan which copies form fields from last gesamtplan (2026). But setup_docu_data deletes `dynform_field WHERE version >= 2027`. And the 2026 gesamtplan exists in dump? The dump has only 2023 and 2024. The 2026 plan was created by setup_docu_data as a fresh insert `INSERT INTO gesamtplan (jahr, archived, approval_end) VALUES (2026,1,1)` WITHOUT copying dynform_field. So dynform_field for 2026 is empty. Hence creating 2027 copies empty fields, and then Fachplanung creation hits the trailing comma SQL error.

So this is arguably a test-data artifact: in a real deployment the dump's last gesamtplan (2024) has dynform_field definitions. The 2026 plan being inserted without form fields is an artifact of setup_docu_data. However, the documented cypress run (030/031) presumably is meant to work. The summary claims 030 had 1/3 fail due to "expected 2027 test data not present". 

Hmm. But actually the trailing comma bug only manifests when there are zero form field definitions for the target version. In the real workflow from the dump: last plan = 2024 which has dynform_field (33 massnahme + 50 teilmassnahme). Creating a new plan 2025 would copy those. Then Fachplanung creation would have non-empty fields, so no trailing comma. So app works in normal data flow.

The failures 030/031/033 are all due to the 2026 plan inserted by setup_docu_data lacking dynform_field and zweck data. This is a doc-data artifact rather than the installation being broken.

But wait — 030's first test (create 2027 Gesamtplan) passed; the second test (initiate Fachplanungen) failed at `input[id="fp-9901"]` not found because 9901 didn't exist at that moment (setup-docu-data had deleted it, and running 030 standalone doesn't create it). Let me check the full sequence more carefully: 030 had 3 tests, 1 passing 1 failing (1 skipped due to stop-on-failure). The passing was test 1. The failing was test 2 at `.alert-info` not visible — because save produced alert-danger (DB error). That's the trailing comma issue again, from the empty 2026 dynform_field.

Hmm, but 2026 dynform_field empty is because setup_docu_data inserted 2026 plan directly without copying fields. This is by design of the test-data script, but it means the app's own workflow (create 2027 plan via UI → copy fields from 2026) legitimately copies nothing. Then creating Fachplanung errors. So is this a real app bug? In a real deployment starting from the dump, you'd create 2025 from 2024 (fields present) → works. So the bug is only triggered when the previous plan lacks field definitions, which is a corrupted/artificial data state created by the docu-data script.
